raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misconstrued the physics of motion initiation by claiming balanced forces explain the start of sliding, conflating the static friction threshold and vertical force balance with the requirement for an unbalanced net force to cause acceleration. This led to prematurely declaring the task complete and selecting A instead of the correct B.
